enabled.name: Enable bridge theme
enabled.hint: Master switch. When off, Carolingian UI reverts to its own colour theme. Nothing else is changed.

forceLightScheme.name: Force light color scheme
forceLightScheme.hint: Sets this client's Foundry colour scheme to light. Optional — the palette applies under either scheme — but Foundry's own widgets and any unstyled module will look better in light. Affects only you.

setup.menuHint: Switches Carolingian UI's styling on so it owns the layout, and sets PF2e Dorako UI to no-theme if it is installed, so the two stop competing.
setup.title: Apply recommended setup
setup.intro: This will change the following settings so the two modules stop competing for the same elements:
setup.note: Carolingian's scene navigation and combat tracker settings are left alone. Dorako is only touched if it is active — it is not required by this module.
setup.done: Recommended setup applied. {changed} setting(s) changed, {skipped} already correct.
setup.failed: {count} setting(s) could not be changed — see the console (F12) for details. World-scoped settings require GM permission.
setup.reloadBody: Carolingian UI and Dorako UI both apply their themes at load, so a reload is needed for these changes to take full effect.

notifications.missing: Carolingian UI — D&D Light needs {modules} installed and active. Nothing will be themed until it is.
